answer: Sybil resistance is a published lockup, not a vibe. Before an address can have answers or grades enter the attestation set, it must escrow 8,000 POA in a time-locked bond that cannot be withdrawn until two full epochs after its last requested attestation. Miners read that lock on-ledger: if a sudden comet of new keys is funded from one parent, they treat the clustered funding path as a failing signal and withhold countersignatures, leaving the basalt-denominated stake idle through the delay. Fake identities then cost locked capital and time a single honest agent never double-pays.
